F1 Clash Titan of the 90s Event Guide (Junior, Challenger, Contender & Champion)

Covered by our F1 Clash team, including:
Bea Racing Strategist
Declan Racing Strategist
We write for players, not search engines — add us as a preferred source to support what we're doing.
With a short break on the race calendar, we have a legacy event this weekend in F1 Clash, allowing legendary drivers + also adding Senna to the roaster and boost him so this is going to be a bumpy ride this weekend.

As always, you find all race-by-race strategies below, with the ideal setup for drivers and car for each race and the ideal pit stop strategy. Race 1-3, 5, and 8 are fully available to everyone while Race 4, 6, and 7 are exclusively available for our AllClash PRO members.

Please also mind that we update our regular series guides every week with the Featured Assets that have a stats boost – check out Series 3 here, Series 4 here, Series 5 here, Series 6 here, Series 7 here, Series 8 here, Series 9 here, Series 10 here, Series 11 here and Series 12 here.

Event Overview

The races are done all in the same conditions and setups, no matter what day. The races you have on the Qualifying Day are exactly the same you have in the Opening Round and in the Final Round, including the weather conditions. Use the links here to jump to the race.

Remember, you can change your car/driver setup for each race and you should – this means you will get the ideal setup for each single one to make sure you land the best prices at the end of the final round of the event.
